_help: Stand-in keyword text for companion tooltips, keyed by the game's own keyword id (the ids the mod's effect catalog uses). match is a regular expression tested against a perk's text when the perk has no explicit keywords. gap true means the game tooltip source is not found yet. inline true means the game shows it as an icon, so no companion tooltip.

Poison.text: Loses HP each turn, then the amount drops.

Doom.text: Dies if its HP is at or below its Doom total.

Vigor.text: Your next Attack deals extra damage.

Blur.text: Block is not removed next turn.

Regen.text: Heals HP at end of turn.

Exhaust.text: Removed from play until the combat ends.

Ethereal.text: Exhausts if still in hand at end of turn.

Orb.text: Passive effect each turn. Evoke for a burst.

ReplayStatic.text: The card is played an extra time.

Retain.text: Not discarded at the end of your turn.

Channeling.text: Orbs enter your slots when Channeled.
